ai.label: AI Context
ai.tooltip: On Optimize, AI searches the web with this value and uses what it finds to improve the text.

slug.label: Unique Identifier
slug.tooltip: Stable ID for this item. Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only — no spaces.

locale.label: Locale
locale.tooltip: Language version of this text on the CV.

description.label: Description
description.tooltip: Body text shown on the CV for this item.

translation.label: Translation
translation.tooltip: Another language version of this content. Each locale can appear only once.

link.label: Link
link.tooltip: Named URL readers can open from the CV or profile. Only the first link is used for AI web extract.

linkTitle.label: Title
linkTitle.tooltip: Visible label for the link (not the URL).

linkUrl.label: URL
linkUrl.tooltip: Full address. Must start with https:// or http://. Only the first link in the list gets AI web lookup.

image.label: Image
image.tooltip: Image URL shown with this item.

skills.label: Skills
skills.tooltip: Skills demonstrated by this item. Pick from the catalog.

profileSkills.label: Skills
profileSkills.tooltip: Skills listed on the CV. Order here is the order on the CV.

relevance.label: Relevance
relevance.tooltip: CV priority. Higher values appear earlier and get more weight.

period.label: Period
period.tooltip: Start and end dates. Leave the end empty if it is still current.

hours.label: Hours
hours.tooltip: Total duration of the course or training in hours.

url.label: URL
url.tooltip: Main webpage for this item (certificate page, course page, and similar).

organization.label: Organization
organization.tooltip: Company, school, or institution linked to this item.

level.label: Level
level.tooltip: Education level (high school, technical, bachelor’s, and similar).

status.label: Status
status.tooltip: Current state: in progress, completed, or another option.

userRole.label: Account role
userRole.tooltip: Admin access level for this account (user vs super admin).

permissions.label: Permissions
permissions.tooltip: What this API token may do: read only, or also create and update data.

expiresAt.label: Expires at
expiresAt.tooltip: Date after which this token stops working.

website.label: Website
website.tooltip: Official site of this organization. Used for AI web lookup when optimizing.

nickname.label: Nickname
nickname.tooltip: Short public handle shown on the profile.

birthDate.label: Birth date
birthDate.tooltip: Date of birth stored on the profile.

address.label: Address
address.tooltip: Location shown on the profile (city, region, country).

newPassword.label: New password
newPassword.tooltip: Replaces the current password for sign-in.

profileName.label: Name
profileName.tooltip: Full name on the profile and CV.

organizationName.label: Name
organizationName.tooltip: Legal or common name of the company or school. Used for AI web lookup when optimizing.

apiTokenName.label: Name
apiTokenName.tooltip: Label that identifies this token in the list.

skillCategory.label: Category
skillCategory.tooltip: Group name for similar skills on the CV.

organizationCategory.label: Category
organizationCategory.tooltip: Type of organization: company, school, or other.

experienceCategory.label: Category
experienceCategory.tooltip: Employment type: full-time, freelance, internship, and similar.

skillTitle.label: Title
skillTitle.placeholder: e.g. Customer Service, Excel, Team Leadership
skillTitle.tooltip: Skill name as it appears on the CV.

profileTitle.label: Title
profileTitle.tooltip: Headline under your name on the CV.

experienceTitle.label: Title
experienceTitle.tooltip: Job title for this role on the CV.

educationTitle.label: Title
educationTitle.tooltip: Program or degree name on the CV.

courseTitle.label: Title
courseTitle.placeholder: e.g. Food Safety Certification, First Aid
courseTitle.tooltip: Course or certificate name on the CV.

translations.label: Translations
translations.tooltip: Localized title and description. Add one block per language.

images.label: Images
images.tooltip: Extra image URLs for this project.

links.label: Links
links.tooltip: Related websites (demo, repo, case study, and similar).

changeCategory.label: Change Category
changeCategory.tooltip: Applies this category to every selected item.

changeLevel.label: Change Level
changeLevel.tooltip: Applies this education level to every selected education.

changeStatus.label: Change Status
changeStatus.tooltip: Applies this status to every selected item.

changeRelevance.label: Change Relevance
changeRelevance.tooltip: Applies this CV relevance to every selected item.

changePermissions.label: Change Permissions
changePermissions.tooltip: Applies these permissions to every selected token.

changeRole.label: Change account role
changeRole.tooltip: Applies this account role to every selected user.

fieldArray.emptyDescription: Click on the button below to add your first item
